output.summary: An annual or short-lived perennial herb native to the Americas, Mexican tea has irregular branches, long narrow leaves and small green flowers. Its strongly aromatic leaves are used as a vegetable, seasoning and herbal tea, but overdoses of its essential oil have caused deaths.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, preferably collected before seeding, are used as a vegetable, seasoning and herbal tea; the concentrated essential oil can be fatal.
